item.title: Christian lawyers who defended nurses over single-sex changing room celebrate court win
item.description: Andrea Williams, chief executive of the Christian Legal Centre, which supported the nurses, said, "Allowing a man into a female-only space because he claims to be a woman violates human dignity, common sense, the law of the land and biblical truth."

item.title: Youth café growth reflects increasing church engagement across Suffolk
item.description: A Thursday evening youth café in Ipswich is offering a snapshot of a wider story unfolding across Suffolk, as churches report encouraging growth in attendance, community engagement and outreach - particularly among children and young people.

item.title: Report reveals religious and political shifts in UK
item.description: Faith identity and ideology "are assuming a more significant role in shaping political allegiance, civic participation, and the wider culture", a new report has found.

item.title: Sir Brian Souter says the nation is 'seeing a rebirth of Christ-centred Christianity'
item.description: Sir Brian Souter, the founder of Stagecoach and Megabus, has spoken candidly about the role of Christian faith in business and his view that Britain’s increasingly secular culture may be giving rise to a renewed and more authentic form of Christianity.
